set.body:
Phase B (assurance floor; gates Phase D).

CORRECTION TO THE RECORD: -Werror was never enabled, and two plan documents assert that it is.

build.sbt:15 is the only scalacOptions line in the build:
    ThisBuild / scalacOptions ++= Seq("-Xmax-inlines:64", "-language:strictEquality")

tlFatalWarnings is never set, and sbt-typelevel 0.8.7 defaults it to false (verified by decompiling sbt-typelevel-settings_2.12_1.0-0.8.7.jar: TypelevelSettingsPlugin.globalSettings sets it from a method whose bytecode is iconst_0; ireturn). The generated ci.yml never overrides it. So -Werror is appended nowhere, locally or in CI.

Documents that claim otherwise and must be corrected as part of this bead:
- docs/plans/2026-07-23-site-layer.md:53 ("-Werror in CI") and :257 ("green under -Werror")
- docs/plans/2026-07-26-evidence-coherence-representation.md:38 (listed as Phase 4a work)

Credit where due: -language:strictEquality IS on, which is a real and unusual discipline win. It is not fatal warnings.

Acceptance: tlFatalWarnings := true, full build green, and CI demonstrated to fail on a deliberately introduced warning.
set.title: P8.B1: Enable fatal warnings
